questionsToConsider: Is this for proposals, finished work or both, and do you need the choice question at all?
Which file types can your reviewers open, and how large are typical submissions?
Do reviewers need to know who did what on a team project?
Is there a deadline, and should the greeting say it?
guide.howToUseResponses: Export the submissions to CSV and share the list with reviewers, split into proposals and finished work since they are judged differently. Give each reviewer the same criteria and a column to score against. For team projects, the breakdown of who did what helps when marks or credit are shared out. Reply to every submitter once a decision is made.
customizeSteps: Change the submission types, or remove the question if you only take one kind.
Adjust the accepted file types and size limit to what your reviewers can open.
Share the link with your class, applicants or team, or embed it on the brief page.

faqs.q: What should a project submission form include?
faqs.a: Contact details, the project title, a short summary, the team, the files and any links such as a demo or repository. A confirmation that the work is original is common for courses and competitions.
Yes. This form accepts up to five files, including PDFs, documents, slides, images and zip archives. You can change the types and limits when you edit the question.

faqs.q: How do I handle team project submissions?
faqs.a: Ask one person to submit for the team and list the others. This form asks for each team member and what they contributed only when it's a team project.

faqs.q: Can I use this for student assignments?
faqs.a: Yes. Remove the budget question, rename the submission types to your assignment stages, and share the link with the class.
